label: Monado MIC
title: Monado MIC (Valve Index)
intro: The MIC calibration recordings of the Monado SLAM Datasets, made with a Valve Index headset: its front fisheye pair and its IMU, 8 camera-only and 8 camera + IMU recordings.
reading: Chart centre. Each chart is centred on the Monado authors' own Basalt calibration of this headset, made from one recording: extras/calibration.raw.json for the camera–IMU distance, baseline and time offset, and its kb4 version (calibration.json) for the intrinsics. Their IMU terms are not used: the released recordings appear to carry the authors' IMU correction already, so those charts, and t_ga, are centred on the MVIS median.
no_repeatability: This study has no repeatability cells: they are computed for the leaderboard batch only. Each tool's spread over the 8 recordings of a family is in Parameters by sensor.
study_note: Separate study (batch 2026-11-25): MVIS, Kalibr and Basalt on the 8 MIC camera-only and 8 camera + IMU recordings, run outside the leaderboard batch, so it has no row here.

families.title: cam0 + cam1 stereo
families.read_first: Each tool calibrates both cameras and their baseline from the images alone, on the 8 camcalib recordings.
notes: Every tool ran on the same 8 recordings, each with its own camera model: MVIS equidistant, Kalibr pinhole-equi and Basalt kb4, the same polynomial.
kb4, the camera model of the other tools.

families.read_first: Kalibr's intrinsics and baselines are inputs from its own camera-only calibration; its td, lever and IMU intrinsics are solved given them.
